description: Which signature format each repository's commits take, and the commit that ends the old signing there (agent-fabric ADR-057 §5 rules 1, 3, 5). The shape is identities/schemas/signing.schema.json. A repository is named owner/name as one of its projects/registry.json remotes names it; listing it is what makes bootstrap write its working copies' signing settings (gpg.format, gpg.program and gpg.ssh.program = fabric-sign, user.signingkey, commit.gpgsign). since is the full sha on the repository's default branch from which the checker (tools/fabric/guards/ban_unsigned_commits.py) applies rule 5 to every commit not reachable from it; null: not cut over yet, and nothing is refused under rule 5. An entry's missing key is the default's.
